---
title: "Coordinates, facets, and composition API"
toc-depth: 3
---

Coordinate methods flip, zoom, or change the coordinate system, facet methods split a plot into panels by a field, and `Compose` places separate plots side by side or in a grid. [Facets and composition](facets.qmd) shows them with examples.
